related_questions.title: Possible symptoms include:
list: Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing.
New loss of taste or smell.

text_blocks.snippet: To help COVID-19 go away, focus on supportive care like rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications to manage symptoms. For individuals at higher risk of severe illness, antiviral medications may be prescribed to help prevent the virus from multiplying. Consult a healthcare professional for personalized advice and treatment options.
snippet_highlighted_words: focus on supportive care like rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications to manage symptoms

list.title: Rest and Hydration:
list.snippet: Getting enough sleep and drinking plenty of fluids helps your body's natural defenses fight the virus.

list.title: Symptom Management:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter medications like fever reducers (acetaminophen or ibuprofen), pain relievers, and cough medicine can help alleviate symptoms.

list.title: Antiviral Medications:
list.snippet: If you are at higher risk of severe illness, your doctor may prescribe antiviral medications to help reduce the severity of the illness and prevent it from worsening, according to the CDC.

list.title: Consult a Healthcare Professional:
list.snippet: It's crucial to consult with a doctor to determine the best course of action for your specific situation, especially if you have underlying health conditions or are at higher risk of complications.

related_questions.question: What does the very beginning of COVID feel like?

text_blocks.snippet: The initial symptoms of COVID-19 can feel similar to a mild cold or other respiratory illnesses, with possible symptoms like fatigue, sore throat, and mild cough. Some individuals might also experience a headache or fever. The severity of symptoms can vary widely, and it's important to be mindful of even mild symptoms as they can potentially worsen.
snippet_highlighted_words: similar to a mild cold or other respiratory illnesses, with possible symptoms like fatigue, sore throat, and mild cough

text_blocks.snippet: Early Symptoms (may include, but not limited to):

list.snippet: Fatigue: Feeling unusually tired or drained.
Sore Throat: A scratchy or painful throat.
Mild Cough: A cough that may not be severe initially.
Headache: A mild to moderate headache.

list.title: Varied Severity:
list.snippet: Symptoms can range from mild to severe, and some people may not experience any symptoms at all.

list.title: Evolving Symptoms:
list.snippet: Symptoms may start mild and then progress to more severe ones.

list.title: Individual Differences:
list.snippet: Symptoms can vary depending on vaccination status, previous infection, and the specific variant of the virus.

list.title: Consult a Doctor:
list.snippet: If you have concerns about your symptoms, it's always best to consult with a healthcare professional.
